reportedSymptom.title: 未能完成适配
reportedSymptom.evidenceText: 上传至分组：请选择 网络图片：本地图片：仅支持 gif、jpeg、png、bmp 4种格式，大小不超过1.0 MB

rootCauses: The broad /network|timeout/ stop pattern treated the content-source label network image as a network failure.
The controller mapped every safety flag to OFFICIAL_TOOL_REQUIRED.
The stopped card rendered the same error once as status text and once as a separate alert.
fixes: Require explicit network-error or timeout wording before emitting NETWORK_OR_TIMEOUT.
Require explicit obligation wording before emitting OFFICIAL_TOOL_REQUIRED.
Map each safety flag to a stable truthful error code and message.
Use one visible error element with role=alert.

regressions.unit: Network image remains actionable with JPEG/PNG and maxBytes=1000000.
regressions.controller: A real network timeout stops with NETWORK_OR_TIMEOUT, not OFFICIAL_TOOL_REQUIRED.
regressions.ui: The network error is rendered once and exactly one alert remains.
